snippet.title: Codenames App vs. Online: Which One is for You?
snippet.description:
Codenames App, the official adaptation of one of the most popular board games, is live!

Download the game, explore its new features—like new game modes, thematic missions, daily challenges, and turn-based gameplay—and let us know how you like it!

App Store link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/codenames/id1055650930
Google Play link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details
